contexts.text: To commit adultery with stone and wood = to pervert the truths and goods of outward worship. AC 5156:end.
Not to commit adultery = that truth is not to be falsified.
To commit adultery, to commit adultery, and to commit whoredom = to pervert the goods and to falsify the truths of the doctrine of faith and charity.
They that commit adultery = the falsification of truth. AE 164.
The man said, I am no longer a husband, but an adulterer.

Thou shalt not commit adultery. In the natural sense, this commandment means not only to commit adultery, but also to will and do obscene things, and thence to think and speak lascivious ones. Illustrated, Explained.
In the spiritual sense, by committing adultery is meant to adulterate the goods of the Word, and to falsify its truths. Illustrated.
In the celestial sense, by committing adultery is meant to deny the holiness of the Word and to profane it. They do this who at heart laugh at all things of the Church and of religion.
Adulterers = those who falsify the knowledges of truth.
